headline: Subdivision at 9 Lamb Road and one-year extension for 15-unit residential project at 106 Pine Street.
summary: The agenda lists a two-lot subdivision at 9 Lamb Road and a one-year extension of a site plan for 15 units at 106 Pine Street. It also lists a motion to enter nonpublic session on pending claims or litigation.

November 19, 2026 
AGENDA 
 
To: NCPB Members 
 
From: Planning Staff 
 
Re: Regular Meeting and Public Hearing December 3, 2026 
 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua Planning Board will occur on Thursday, 
December 3, 2026 at 7:00 PM at the Nashua City Hall located at 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH. The public 
may submit their comments in advance of the meeting via email pb@nashuanh.gov or by mail (please make 
sure to include your name/address and comments) by 4PM on December 2, 2026. Letters should be addressed 
to City of Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. Plans can be viewed online 
starting November 30, 2026 at https://nashuanh.portal.civicclerk.com/. The public may request access via 
Zoom; contact the Planning Department before 4PM on December 2, 2026, for a link. 
 
A. Call to Order 
B. Roll Call  
C. Approval of Minutes – November 19, 2026 
D. Communications 
E. Report of Chairman, Committee, & Liaison 
F. Executive Session 
 
NEW BUSINESS – SUBDIVISION PLANS 
A26-0214  The Suzanne P. Raisanen Rev. Trust of 1995 (Owner & Applicant) requesting approval of a 
two-lot subdivision. Property is located at 9 Lamb Road. Map B – Lot 241. Zoned Rural 
Residence (R-40). Ward 9. 
 
NEW BUSINESS – SITE PLANS 
A26-0228  Marguerites Place, Inc. (Owner & Applicant) requesting a one-year extension for approved site 
plan for 15-unit residential with associated site improvements, originally approved on October 
17th, 2024, and further extended December 4th, 2025. Property is located at 106 Pine Street. 
Sheet 84 – Lot 134. Zoned C-Urban Residence (R-C). Ward 4. 
 
OTHER BUSINESS 
1. Review of tentative agenda to determine developments of regional impact.

DISCUSSION ITEMS 
 
None  
 
NONPUBLIC SESSION 
The Planning Board will need to make a motion to enter into a Nonpublic Session under RSA 91-A:3, II (e) 
for consideration or negotiation of pending claims or litigation which has been threatened in writing or filed 
against the public body. 
NEXT MEETING: January 7, 2027 (Tentative) 
 
ADJOURN
